messages.subject: Error in dsm
parts:
Hi all
I cant figure out the error listed below

off.set <-0.25*1000*1000
mod1.pred <-predict(mod1, preddata, off.set)
pp <-cbind(preddata, mod1.pred)
p <-ggplot(pp) +gg.opts
p <-p+geom_tile(aes(x=x,y=y,fill =mod1.pred, width =width,height =height))
p <-p+coord_equal()
p <-p+geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y),data =survey.area)
p <-p+labs(fill ="Abundance")
print(p)
Error in if ((w[1] * sm + w[2] * cm + w[3] * dm + w[4]) < best$score) break : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
please help me in understanding error..will be very grateful.

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error in dsm
parts:
This seems like odd behaviour and not something I've seen before.

I was unable to reproduce the issue on my machine using the example
dolphins data.

A couple of follow-up questions that might aid the diagnosis:

1) Does the error definitely occur after the print(p) an not before?
2) If "yes" above: it's possible that your gg.opts includes something
unusual, perhaps incompatible with what dsm gives you. If you can paste
what gg.opts is perhaps we can see what the offending code is?
3) If "no" to 1): Are you using up-to-date R and packages (you can
ensure you have the most recent versions from CRAN using
update.packages()). If that doesn't work, if you can send (direct to me
rather than the Google Group your data and code that reproduces the
error I can take a look.

best,
--dave
